footnotes: In the flow chart, Other Bets revenue ($1.5B) is shown net of hedging losses ($100M). Segment operating income excludes Alphabet-level activities.
Free cash flow = operating cash flow − purchases of property & equipment (calculated). Net income includes $29.8B of other income, net.
Diluted EPS by quarter as reported in the 10-Qs; fourth quarters are calculated (net income ÷ estimated diluted shares) because EPS does not add across quarters.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Alphabet's revenue grew 15.1% to $402.8B in 2025, its first year above $400B. Google Search & other rose 13.4% to $224.5B and Google Cloud 35.8% to $58.7B. Operating income rose 14.8% to $129.0B.
Net income jumped 32.0% to $132.2B, or $10.81 per diluted share, helped by $29.8B of other income. Capital spending rose 74% to $91.4B, leaving free cash flow roughly flat at $73.3B.
highlights: Google Cloud operating income more than doubled to $13.9B, and its margin rose to 23.7% from 14.1%.
Q4 2025 revenue reached a record $113.8B, up 18% from a year earlier.
Cash and marketable securities rose to $126.8B.
watch: Capital expenditures rose 74% to $91.4B, and Alphabet expects $175B–$185B in 2026.
Other Bets' operating loss widened to $7.5B, and Alphabet-level costs rose to $16.8B.
Net income was lifted by $29.8B of other income, which may not recur.
sources: Alphabet Q4 and fiscal year 2025 results
